title: Screen
drDigitalIntro:
We will go through the laptop a part at a time, starting with the screen.
• The screen is the part you're looking at right now.
• It's made of millions of tiny colored lights called pixels.
• Together they show everything — words, pictures, and videos.
drDigitalSuccess: That is the screen. Everything the laptop does, it does where you can see it.
drDigitalHint: Take a look at your own screen, then click Continue whenever you are ready.
